section_summary.extract_value: This section details the factor analysis of the Portuguese Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in the present study. An Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) identified two factors: General body appreciation and Body image investment. The study found a total sample size of 311 participants, with men reporting significantly higher General body appreciation than women. Due to a low alpha coefficient for the Body image investment subscale, only the General body appreciation factor was retained for further analyses. Table 2 presents the factor loadings for the items.
